questions: What is consent?
If consent is withdrawn, does everything have to stop?
What is a conflict of interest?
If a conflict of interest is disclosed, is it no longer a problem?
What does privacy protect?
If privacy is protected, can the information still be used?
What is autonomy?
When autonomy increases, does someone else lose control?
What is risk?
If the risk is low, does that make it acceptable?
What is integrity?
If integrity is broken, can it be restored by putting everything back?
What does transparency require?
If transparency increases, can everyone see everything?
What is capacity?
If capacity drops, can someone else simply take over?
What is justice?
If justice is blind, does it treat everyone exactly the same?
What is a duty?
When a duty ends, is nothing still owed?
What is a vulnerability?
If a vulnerability is fixed, is the person no longer vulnerable?
How does triage work?
When triage puts someone last, do they stay last?
What does disclosure require?
Once disclosure is made, is the decision settled?
What is a waiver?
If a waiver is granted, do the usual safeguards disappear?
What counts as harm?
If no one is hurt, was there no harm?
